conclusion: The bipartite A/-A picture reduces Erdos #126 to one counting statement: g(k) <= N_2(k) + 2 where N_2(k) is the maximum number of solutions of a two-term S-unit equation u - v = c over |S| = k and c in Q*, so log N_2(k) = o(k) implies the conjecture. The briefed within-part pair-sum structure yields no improvement in the exponent, only a free nondegeneracy guarantee, and the Gyory-Hajdu-Tijdeman line is representability rather than counting and contains no bound of the form |A| <= F(|S|).
confidence: Theorem 1 and its proof are elementary and self-contained; lean on them fully. Corollary 2's explicit constant depends on Evertse 1984's 3*7^(d+2s) as I recall it, which I did not re-read in-session, so treat the numeral 3.892 as needing one citation check while the exp(O(k)) shape is safe. Corollary 3's conditional is only as strong as the uniformity of the expected subexponential truth in the coefficients alpha, beta, which I flagged as unverified. Section 8 rests on abstracts because both PDFs came back as undecoded binary.
